en.title: Signal Filter
en.description:
A signal must fall within all closed intervals at once; count the frequencies that pass every filter.

See "Input" for the standard input/output conventions and constraints added by this site.
en.input: n,m≤100000; frequencies and endpoints are 32-bit integers. Input n m, the frequencies, and m intervals.
en.explanation: The intersection runs from the largest left bound to the smallest right bound; iterate and count the frequencies that fall within this closed interval.
